conbody.p: Emergency Braking can alert you with the Forward Safety warning light blinking (), a warning message, an audible warning and steering wheel vibration (if equipped). Emergency Braking may activate to help avoid a collision with an oncoming vehicle.
Emergency Braking may be activated in the following conditions:

li.p: Your driving speed is approximately 10-30 km/h (6-19 mph).
The oncoming vehicle speed is approximately 25-85 km/h (16-53 mph).
The motorcyclist or cyclist speed is approximately 15-85 km/h (9-53 mph).
A target enters the operating range of the Junction Turning function.
